يحتفلن (form VIII)
# يَحْتَفِلْنَ (yaḥtafilna) /jaħ.ta.fil.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# يُحْتَفَلْنَ (yuḥtafalna) /juħ.ta.fal.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
